flow.name: axn-term - real claude resume record carries the conversation name
flow.description: Real claude in an axn-term session: an empty conversation (named with /rename, then /exit) leaves no resume record; a conversation with one tiny haiku prompt does, and the record (last + history) carries the /rename name although claude clears its terminal title on exit.

step.description: Create a temp state dir (real claude, no fake binary)
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Run real claude, /rename the empty conversation, wait for the plugin to see the name

assert.description: The name was seen while claude ran

step.description: /exit the empty conversation — nothing may be recorded

assert.description: An empty conversation leaves no resume record

step.description: Run real claude (haiku), /rename, send one tiny prompt, wait for the answer

assert.description: claude ended and the record exists

step.description: The resume record and history carry the name and the conversation id
The ended session shows the Resume button with the conversation name

assert.value: resume button shows: Resume claude session
assert.description: The button's gate holds and its label carries the name

step.description: The name survives in the saved state
